coverage: Concrete source-route families with labelled design records; NOT a full published-record inventory or real-data parity claim

nextGate: Approved SELECT-only source connection, actual published-record/media/relationship parity and isolated backend workflow verification; no deployment

validation.note: Preview validation only; automated scans are not WCAG certification and no real database or production parity is claimed

sourceStates.fixture: No database variables supplied: labelled synthetic records and approved photography
sourceStates.unavailable: Any partial/invalid/unverified supplied source: sanitized known-route screen with no fallback records
sourceStates.database: Optional adapter returns verified read-only public records; only exact allowlisted family/slug/url pairs extend the route registry

queryRules.arrays: Ignored, never string-cast or used as selectors
queryRules.textLimits: Search 120 bytes, selectors 64 bytes, comparison IDs 500 bytes; invalid UTF-8/control characters ignored
queryRules.pagination: Blog nine per page; invalid/oversized page normalizes to 1; valid out-of-range page clamps to last page; filters preserved in links
queryRules.comparison: Comma-separated actual itinerary ID allowlist, deduplicated, maximum four
queryRules.transitions: GET filters/search only; no saves, customer sessions, messages, consent changes or external processing

fixtures.reviews: Empty; no invented ratings or testimonials
fixtures.partnerFlag: NEW_SITE_DEMO_PARTNERS=1 only; default disabled; fictional directory/category/detail/application, no real settings

contracts.homepage: Existing approved hero/destinations/journeys/experiences/articles/reviews/active_journey keys retained; card targets now real demo details
contracts.record: id,slug,title,summary,image,image_alt,url,label,demo plus sourced or explicitly illustrative optional sections
contracts.duration: Detail record.days is timeline array, duration_days integer; collection card.days integer; approved homepage fixture cards retain original no-days shape
contracts.article: Plain text sections with stable id/heading/text; sample educational label; no invented authors or dates

families.resolution: Concrete tour first, explicit category fallback second

constraints: synthetic service information, no actual rates or terms
approved published status unavailable in this source
no fabricated policy or trust claims

limitations: No real database connection or published-record enumeration was performed.

Source adapter currently maps six catalogue families and itinerary day rows only; original relationships, settings, reviews, guides, static policies and private account records are not claimed as covered.
Sample guides demonstrate educational page layouts, not verified CMS advice, visa guidance, weather, availability, travel times or prices.
Policy/trust publication is not inferred from unrelated project memory or original data; approved text is not copied or fabricated.
Standalone tests validate model and routing contracts; browser, security and preservation validation is coordinated separately.
